Gaussian input

Link 0 commands

The Link 0 commands set the job’s memory, processors and files before the route; each is explained after the Gaussian manual.

Command Value Meaning
%OldChk Checkpoint file copied into this job’s checkpoint at the start, to read data from a previous calculation.
%Chk Checkpoint file this job writes.
%Mem 1 GB Dynamic memory available to Gaussian.
%NProcShared 1 Number of processors used in shared-memory parallel execution.

Route keywords and options

The route selects the method, basis set and job type: each keyword with its meaning and options, as Gaussian read them.

Keyword

Meaning

Options

Option

Value

Meaning

PM6D3

PM6 semi-empirical method with Grimme’s D3 dispersion correction.

Opt

Geometry optimization to a stationary point.

TS

Optimize to a transition structure rather than a minimum.

ReadAllGIC

Read the generalized internal coordinates from the checkpoint file.

CalcFC

Compute the force constants at the first point with the current method.

Tight

Tighter cutoffs on forces and step size for convergence.

MaxCycles

120

At most 120 optimization steps.

MaxStep

5

Maximum step, the initial trust radius, of 5\times 0.01\,a_0 or 5\times 0.01\,\mathrm{rad}.

RecalcFC

5

Compute analytic second derivatives at the first step and then every 5 steps.

Freq

Harmonic force constants, vibrational frequencies, intensities and thermochemistry.

NoRaman

Skip the Raman intensities.

Geom

Source and handling of the molecule specification.

AllCheck

Take the geometry, charge, multiplicity and title from the checkpoint file.

Guess

Initial guess for the SCF wavefunction.

Read

Read the initial guess from the checkpoint file.

SCF

Controls of the self-consistent field procedure.

Tight

Tight SCF convergence, the default.

XQC

Add a quadratically convergent SCF step if the first-order SCF has not converged.

MaxCycle

512

At most 512 SCF cycles.

NoSymm

Keep the input orientation and do not use molecular symmetry.

Geometry optimization

The geometry optimization took 8 steps:

  • The first plot follows the energy E-E_{\mathrm{final}} step by step.
  • The second divides Gaussian’s four convergence criteria by their thresholds; a step converges when all four fall below 1.

Geometries along the job

Every geometry Gaussian printed during the job, in order, trailed by faded copies of the preceding ones.

Vibrational frequencies

The harmonic analysis gave 84 modes, 3 of them imaginary. The stick spectrum places each mode’s infrared intensity at its wavenumber \tilde{\nu}, imaginary modes at negative \tilde{\nu}.

The viewer animates, one at a time in its snapshot selector:

  • Shown are every imaginary mode, the six lowest real modes and the four most intense in the infrared.
  • Each moves its atoms by at most 0.6\,\mathrm{\AA}, trailed by faded frames.
